TIP.name: iShares TIPS Bond ETF
TIP.business_summary: The index tracks the performance of inflation-protected public obligations of the U.S.
TIP.fund_description: The index tracks the performance of inflation-protected public obligations of the U.S. Treasury, commonly known as “TIPS,” that have a remaining maturity of more than one year.
